page.layout: One printed page, one column of running text with no headings and no marginal notes. Below the text is the catchword "per-" at the right.

main_text.l: Pœnitentium post ambonem stationes,
explicarentur: cùm autem interior illa
figura & structura non parum illustrari
possit Templi Hierosolymitani, qvale
erat Jesu Christi & Apostolorum sæculo,
comparatione (multa enim ad illius
exemplar instituerunt primi Ecclesiæ fun-
datores) nonnulla etiam de illius deli-
neatione cogitaveram; verùm qvod pau-
culis capitulis me conficere posse spera-
bam, fæcunditate materiæ in molem ex-
crevit: ideo separato libello hæc edere
constitui, iisqve illustrationis causa ad-
dere, qvæ Judæi de Templi structura
commentantur, atqve ut id ordine &
di-lucide fiat, R. Mosis Malmonidis[?] de tem-
plo sive domo electa tractatum Latinita-
te donare, qvo abundè Christianis sup-
peditabitur, qvid hac de re Judæorum
traditiones commemorant.
Qvoniam autem Eminentia Vestra de
qvibusdam libris Parisiis recens editis ad
me scribit, qvos cum Ecclesiæ adversa-
riis paria facere ait, spem facit opportu-no
remedio se curaturum, ne ex eorum

page.notes: Malmonidis: the scan reads "Malmonidis", which may be the printer's "Maimonidis"; marked [?]. The catchword "per-" is set in bold at the right below the last line. Faint specks and marks on the page are not printed text.
